description: This file defines an interface 'AdvancedCallableResolverInterface' within the 'Slim\Interfaces' namespace. It extends the 'CallableResolverInterface' and declares two methods, 'resolveRoute' and 'resolveMiddleware', which are intended to resolve various representations into callables, used in the context of the Slim PHP framework for web applications.

classes.name: AdvancedCallableResolverInterface
classes.description: An interface that extends 'CallableResolverInterface' and adds methods for resolving routes and middleware into callables.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves '$toResolve' into a callable, intended for route resolution.

methods.name: resolveMiddleware
methods.description: Resolves '$toResolve' into a callable, intended for middleware resolution.
